---
title: "LC/MS RRF distributions and uncertainty factors"
subtitle: "Censored Normal, log-normal and gamma fits and UF values for LC/MS RRF data (Jordi 2020, Kritikos 2023, Jenke 2022, FDA CLAP), plus a UF-only entry computed from published mean/SD for Christiaens 2020 Part 2. Structure follows RRFdistcens_figure4.qmd / GCMS_RRF_fit_UF.qmd."
format: html
editor: visual
---

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(patchwork)
```

# Data

RRF values were read from the source PDFs (and the pre-existing Kritikos data) and are inlined below as vectors. `NA` marks a non-detect (ND); zeros in the Jenke vectors are non-detects reported as 0. Both are left-censored at the LOQ by `make_cens`.

- Kritikos 2023 — full per-compound slope-derived RRFs: LC-MS POS (35, including the IS's own entry, pentaerythritol tetraacrylate, RRF = 1.0), LC-MS NEG (22, including the IS's own entry, bromophenol blue, RRF = 1.0).
- Jordi 2020 — Table 2 partial list (LCMS POS and NEG columns). The full 217 compounds appear only as a histogram in the paper, so only the tabulated subset is fitted here. The surrogate itself (Irganox 245) is not one of the tabulated rows.
- Jenke 2022 — Table III, 25 compounds (LC/MS-APCI and LC/MS-ESI). The \~1193-compound database is not tabulated per compound; its summary statistics are used in the last section.
- FDA CLAP (Chemicals List for Analytical Performance) — `processed_data/LCMS.xlsx`, GC-MS's companion LC-MS run of the same reference standard list. LC-MS POS (57 compounds, including the IS itself, Butyryl trihexyl citrate, RRF = 1.0) and LC-MS NEG (28 compounds, including the IS itself, Benzophenone-1, RRF = 1.0), each reported at 5/10/20 µg/mL. NEG is heavily censored (only 9 of 28 compounds detected at any level), so only log-normal and gamma are fitted for NEG — a plain Normal fit does not converge meaningfully on 9 points, mirroring the choice already made for this exact data in `RRF_dist_AIC_comparison_v2.qmd`.
- Christiaens 2020 Part 2 — Table I, summary statistics only (no per-compound table) for the Nelson LC-MS (APCI & ESI) database: n = 1129, mean = 0.543, SD = 0.921. The paper's own footnote flags that these particular figures are APCI-only despite the column header combining APCI and ESI; reported as-is with that caveat. No individual RRFs are tabulated, so this is a UF-only (mean/SD) entry, not a Turnbull fit.

Each source uses a different internal standard and normalisation, so UF values are read per dataset and mode and are not pooled. The surrogate used by each dataset is listed as a column in both UF tables below.

**Censoring convention (Turnbull NPMLE):** values that are 0 or at/below the LOQ (0.001) are treated as left-censored at the LOQ rather than dropped.

```{r}
loq <- 0.001
gamma_params <- data.frame()
norm_params  <- data.frame()
aic_params   <- data.frame()

make_cens <- function(v) {
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  data.frame(
    left  = ifelse(is.na(v) | v <= loq, NA,  v),
    right = ifelse(is.na(v) | v <= loq, loq, v)
  )
}
```

# LC/MS Analysis

## Kritikos 2023 — POS

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(krit_pos)

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm")
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(fnorm); summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

aic_params <- rbind(aic_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Kritikos POS",
  Normal = AIC(fnorm), LogNormal = AIC(flnorm), Gamma = AIC(fgamma)
))

gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Kritikos POS",
  shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]
))

norm_params <- rbind(norm_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Kritikos POS",
  mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]
))

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = cens_data$right)
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm,  args = list(mean    = fnorm$estimate["mean"],    sd    = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),       aes(color = "Normal"),     linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm, args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape   = fgamma$estimate["shape"],  rate  = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),   aes(color = "Gamma"),      linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution",
                     values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "Kritikos POS: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") + theme_minimal()
p_fit

qq_norm  <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qnorm,  dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm, dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

(qq_norm + qq_lnorm + qq_gamma)
```

## Jenke 2022 — APCI (Table III subset)

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(jenke_apci)

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm")
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(fnorm); summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

aic_params <- rbind(aic_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Jenke APCI",
  Normal = AIC(fnorm), LogNormal = AIC(flnorm), Gamma = AIC(fgamma)
))

gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Jenke APCI",
  shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]
))

norm_params <- rbind(norm_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Jenke APCI",
  mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]
))

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = cens_data$right)
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm,  args = list(mean    = fnorm$estimate["mean"],    sd    = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),       aes(color = "Normal"),     linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm, args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape   = fgamma$estimate["shape"],  rate  = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),   aes(color = "Gamma"),      linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution",
                     values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
```

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(clap_pos5)
det <- cens_data$right[!is.na(cens_data$left)]
m <- mean(det); s <- sd(det); cv2 <- (s/m)^2

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm",
                       start = list(mean = m, sd = s),
                       optim.method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(mean = 0, sd = 1e-4))
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm",
                       start = list(meanlog = log(m) - 0.5*log(1+cv2), sdlog = sqrt(log(1+cv2))),
                       optim.method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(meanlog = -Inf, sdlog = 1e-4))
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma",
                       start = list(shape = (m/s)^2, rate = m/s^2),
                       optim.method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(shape = 1e-4, rate = 1e-4))

summary(fnorm); summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

aic_params <- rbind(aic_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "CLAP LC-MS POS 5 µg/mL",
  Normal = AIC(fnorm), LogNormal = AIC(flnorm), Gamma = AIC(fgamma)
))
```

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(clap_neg20)
det <- cens_data$right[!is.na(cens_data$left)]
m <- mean(det); s <- sd(det); cv2 <- (s/m)^2

set.seed(123)
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm",
                       start = list(meanlog = log(m) - 0.5*log(1+cv2), sdlog = sqrt(log(1+cv2))),
                       optim.method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(meanlog = -Inf, sdlog = 1e-4))
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma",
                       start = list(shape = (m/s)^2, rate = m/s^2),
                       optim.method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(shape = 1e-4, rate = 1e-4))

summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

aic_params <- rbind(aic_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "CLAP LC-MS NEG 20 µg/mL",
  Normal = NA_real_, LogNormal = AIC(flnorm), Gamma = AIC(fgamma)
))

gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "CLAP LC-MS NEG 20 µg/mL",
  shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]
))

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = cens_data$right)
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm, args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape   = fgamma$estimate["shape"],  rate  = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),   aes(color = "Gamma"),      linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution",
                    values = c("Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "CLAP LC-MS NEG 20 µg/mL: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") + theme_minimal()
p_fit

qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

(qq_lnorm + qq_gamma)
```

## AIC model comparison

AIC for the censored fits (Normal where fitted, log-normal, gamma) per dataset/mode. The `Best` column is computed directly from the fitted AIC values, not assumed — LC/MS RRFs are expected to be right-skewed (mean/median mismatch, RSD often \> 1), so gamma is expected to win most rows, but this is verified per row rather than asserted.

```{r}
aic_params$Best <- c("Normal", "LogNormal", "Gamma")[apply(
  aic_params[, c("Normal","LogNormal","Gamma")], 1,
  function(r) which.min(r)
)]
aic_params[, c("Normal","LogNormal","Gamma")] <- round(aic_params[, c("Normal","LogNormal","Gamma")], 2)
aic_params
```

```{r}
aic_params %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Normal, LogNormal, Gamma) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Dataset, names_to = "Distribution", values_to = "AIC") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Dataset, y = AIC, fill = Distribution)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "LogNormal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "AIC by dataset/mode and distribution (lower = better fit)", x = NULL, y = "AIC") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

# Uncertainty Factors (fitted per-compound data)

Three UF forms are computed from the detected RRFs (v \> loq) of each dataset and mode:

- UF (mean-only) = 1 / μ
- UF (ISO 10993-18:2022) = 1 / (1 − RSD)
- UF (corrected) = 1 / \[μ (1 − RSD)\]

The ISO and corrected forms are undefined when RSD ≥ 1; those cells are set to NA. For most LC/MS modes RSD is above 1, so only the mean-only UF remains computable.

```{r}
surrogates <- c(
  "Kritikos POS"            = "pentaerythritol tetraacrylate",
  "Kritikos NEG"            = "bromophenol blue",
  "Jordi POS"               = "Irganox 245",
  "Jordi NEG"               = "Irganox 245",
  "Jenke APCI"              = "Tinuvin 327",
  "Jenke ESI"               = "caffeine-13C3 (+) / DEHP-d4 (−)",
  "CLAP LC-MS POS 5 µg/mL"  = "Butyryl trihexyl citrate",
  "CLAP LC-MS POS 10 µg/mL" = "Butyryl trihexyl citrate",
  "CLAP LC-MS POS 20 µg/mL" = "Butyryl trihexyl citrate",
  "CLAP LC-MS NEG 5 µg/mL"  = "Benzophenone-1",
  "CLAP LC-MS NEG 10 µg/mL" = "Benzophenone-1",
  "CLAP LC-MS NEG 20 µg/mL" = "Benzophenone-1",
  "Christiaens 2020 Pt.2 LC-MS (APCI & ESI)" = "not stated in this paper"
)

lcms_list <- list("Kritikos POS" = krit_pos,
                  "Kritikos NEG" = krit_neg,
                  "Jordi POS"    = jordi_pos,
                  "Jordi NEG"    = jordi_neg,
                  "Jenke APCI"   = jenke_apci,
                  "Jenke ESI"    = jenke_esi,
                  "CLAP LC-MS POS 5 µg/mL"  = clap_pos5,
                  "CLAP LC-MS POS 10 µg/mL" = clap_pos10,
                  "CLAP LC-MS POS 20 µg/mL" = clap_pos20,
                  "CLAP LC-MS NEG 5 µg/mL"  = clap_neg5,
                  "CLAP LC-MS NEG 10 µg/mL" = clap_neg10,
                  "CLAP LC-MS NEG 20 µg/mL" = clap_neg20)

lcms_uf <- data.frame()
for (nm in names(lcms_list)) {
  x   <- as.numeric(lcms_list[[nm]]); x <- x[!is.na(x) & x > loq]
  mu  <- mean(x); s <- sd(x); rsd <- s / mu; ok <- rsd < 1
  lcms_uf <- rbind(lcms_uf, data.frame(
    Dataset      = nm,
    Surrogate    = surrogates[[nm]],
    n            = length(x),
    mean         = round(mu, 3),
    sd           = round(s, 3),
    RSD          = round(rsd, 3),
    UF_mean      = round(1 / mu, 2),
    UF_ISO       = ifelse(ok, round(1 / (1 - rsd), 2), NA),
    UF_corrected = ifelse(ok, round(1 / (mu * (1 - rsd)), 2), NA)
  ))
}
lcms_uf
```

# Uncertainty Factors (published full-database summaries)

The full Jordi (217), Jenke (\~1193) and Christiaens Part 2 (1129) distributions are not tabulated per compound. Their published mean and %RSD are used directly (%RSD converted to a fraction). Almost every published LC/MS distribution has RSD \> 1, so the ISO and corrected forms are undefined (NA) for those rows.

Christiaens 2020 Part 2's Table I reports both the "all data" statistics and a "quantifiable" subset restricted to RRF between 0.1 and 5.0 (their own footnote c); the quantifiable subset has RSD \< 1 and is the only published LC/MS summary in either file where UF_ISO and UF_corrected are computable.

```{r}
summary_stats <- tribble(
  ~Dataset,                                    ~mean,  ~RSD,   ~Surrogate,
  "Jordi 2020 POS (217)",                       1.00,  1.08,   "Irganox 245",
  "Jordi 2020 NEG (217)",                       1.00,  1.19,   "Irganox 245",
  "Jenke 2022 APCI (all)",                      0.307, 2.45,   "Tinuvin 327",
  "Jenke 2022 APCI (resp.)",                    0.650, 1.52,   "Tinuvin 327",
  "Jenke 2022 ESI (all)",                       0.202, 2.72,   "caffeine-13C3 (+) / DEHP-d4 (−)",
  "Jenke 2022 ESI (resp.)",                     0.663, 1.25,   "caffeine-13C3 (+) / DEHP-d4 (−)",
  "Christiaens 2020 Pt.2 LC-MS (all, n=1129)",  0.543, 1.696,  "not stated in this paper",
  "Christiaens 2020 Pt.2 LC-MS (quantifiable, 0.1-5.0)", 0.749, 0.869, "not stated in this paper"
)

summary_uf <- summary_stats %>%
  mutate(
    ok           = RSD < 1,
    UF_mean      = round(1 / mean, 2),
    UF_ISO       = ifelse(ok, round(1 / (1 - RSD), 2), NA),
    UF_corrected = ifelse(ok, round(1 / (mean * (1 - RSD)), 2), NA)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ok)
summary_uf
```
